filters.F1: scope routing: agent sub-pool sessions/<a>/% (quota 5); scope=global sub-pool unfiltered (brief.ts:202-215,521-539)
filters.F2: `since` window on updated_at (brief.ts:371-374) — inactive in production
filters.F3: SQL proxy pre-rank + LIMIT 500 per sub-pool (brief.ts:377-390)
filters.F5: dedup: id / exact title|one_liner / near-dup containment>=0.6 (brief.ts:420-434)
filters.F6: quota 5+5 capped by mainTarget = n - freshSlots = 8 (brief.ts:436-468)
filters.F7: pinned floor: current-brief items with pain>=0.9 picked first (brief.ts:442-451,819-821)

F1_scope_routing.note: scope=global returns no path pattern (brief.ts:204), so the scope sub-pool sees the whole corpus; F1 alone excludes nothing from the UNION — it only routes 5 of the 8 main slots to sessions/<agent>/%.

F7_pinned_floor.note: pinnable only if already in the no-fresh current brief

F5_dedup.near_dup_alone: NOT MEASURED — greedy containment over 67k signatures is quadratic and only defined relative to the picked set
